decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric has its own page, so the firm has committed to it visibly and invested in it, and one year is too short to judge results, which favors persisting.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is weaker, but it fits the firm's decorative collection and weak early demand can still be read as a launch-phase effect.
The flame-retardant jacquard has its own page and serves the contract and public-sector market, where certification costs are already sunk, so management is strongly inclined to keep it.
The double-face wool-blend fabric is only mentioned on the website, but it matches the firm's direction toward premium natural fibers, so management would keep it for now.

The wool bouclé leno fabric has low visibility and overlaps with Product B, which makes it the most likely to be pruned, yet it is still recent enough that disappointing results can be blamed on temporary market conditions.
